# How to get a return offer from a FAANG internship

**Source:** https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfvBNR9IYCd/ · **Type:** Reel · **Author:** Ryan Peterman · **Saved:** 2026-11-15

## Summary

Engineering managers share strategies for succeeding as a software engineering intern and securing a return offer. Success is driven by project completion speed, reducing code review iterations, and demonstrating initiative through follow-up work. Additionally, productivity is measured by technical depth—such as comprehensive design documents evaluating architectural trade-offs—rather than lines of code written.
